# Copilot PR review instructions

`nrf-frontend` is a submodule of the [`nrf-solution`](https://github.com/DEFRA/nrf-solution) meta-repo.

Before reviewing:

- Read the meta-repo guidance in [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/DEFRA/nrf-solution/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
- Apply the coding standards in [.ai/rules](https://github.com/DEFRA/nrf-solution/blob/main/.ai/rules/index.md).

If the PR relates to a specific area, also read the relevant docs:

- [Boundary file upload](https://github.com/DEFRA/nrf-solution/blob/main/docs/features/boundary-upload/index.md).
- [Defra ID auth](https://github.com/DEFRA/nrf-solution/blob/main/docs/features/authentication/defra-id/index.md).
